DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT

This Distribution Agreement is entered into between Northwind Logistics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Supplier"), and Harbor Point Retail LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Distributor").

1. Governing Law

1.1 This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.

2. Venue

2.1 The parties irrevocably submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Wilmington, Delaware for any action arising out of this Agreement.

2.2 Any action relating to the trademarks licensed under this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York.

3. Term

3.1 This Agreement continues for three years from the Effective Date.
